Game Overview

In Red Sprunki with a Sword, the core idea is straightforward: blast through the frantic chaos as Red Sprunki, dodging and slicing your way through relentless storms of weapons. With quick reflexes and strategic upgrades to your sword, survive endless barrages to climb the leaderboard in this thrilling, relentless adventure. Embrace the rhythm and master the mayhem!
